competition_id_note: ICF ATOS competition 1292; PWW competition page lists the meeting as 2019 ICF Canoe Ocean Racing World Championships
title: 2019 ICF Canoe Ocean Racing World Championships
notes: Built as Madeira_2024_COR: kind WCH with the _COR key suffix (maintainer t123u says "the kind is COR"; COR is not in the contract kind list, question on the PR), discipline "ocean racing", domain "flatwater_ocean" (PADDLETAGGER_CONTRACT.md "Maintainer 2026-10-30: Canoe ocean racing").

Scope: the six WCH SS1 classes (Junior, U23, Senior, men and women), each class its own race. Out of scope and not built (counts on the PR): SS1 Men Paracanoë 7 and Women Paracanoë 1 (book "Resultat Unofficial", printed 12/09/2019), Masters MM1-MM7 and WM1-WM5 (book "course Master", printed 13/09/2019).

RACE_NUMBER: nothing prints a race number; the ICF ATOS unit code of each class is used (CO001 Men Junior=1, CO002 Men U23=2, CO003 Men Senior=3, CO004 Women Junior=4, CO005 Women U23=5, CO006 Women Senior=6).

START_DATE / START_TIME: ICF ATOS schedule for Wednesday 11 Sep 2019: 14:30 Women's SS1 Junior/U23/Senior Final A (one gun), 15:00 Men's SS1 Junior/U23/Senior Final A (one gun); scheduled mass-start clocks, start_times "scheduled". The results book pages of these classes are printed 11/09/2019 18:24.
DISTANCE: no course length is printed in the results book or on the ICF ATOS pages; left empty, question on the PR.
RESULT normalised from the book "1h34:03.41" to HH:MM:SS.fff; ranks and times equal ICF ATOS results for every bib both print. DIFFERENCE not written (ocean rule).

ICF ids: rule 1, the ICF personCode printed on the ICF ATOS start list for the bib (equal on the ATOS results), bound through bind_seat after the name, nation and gender check. Bib 58 Danielle McKENZIE (NZL, Women Senior winner in the book) is on neither ATOS page; rule 3 name search finds no ICF athlete: no_icf_id.
PERSONS NAME/SURNAME: the ICF ATOS start-list split (Given FAMILY) of the same printed names; the book prints FAMILY GIVEN in capitals only.
Bib 37 Samalulu CLIFTON (NZL, Women U23 rank 5): ATOS personCode 72032 is not in the ICF list; same-DOB ICF athlete 142039 (SAM). Seat emptied, gap icf_ids_incomplete, question on the PR.
